Blockquote with multiple paragraphs has each paragraph prefixed

```ruby title="Ruby"
require "html_to_markdown"
result = HtmlToMarkdown.convert('<blockquote><p>First paragraph.</p><p>Second paragraph.</p></blockquote>')
puts result.inspect
```
